title: A use-after-free in present_clear_window_notifies() in the X.org X Server before 21.1.25 and X Wayland before 24.1.14…
description: A use-after-free vulnerability exists in the present_clear_window_notifies() function in the X.org X Server versions before 21.1.25 and X Wayland versions before 24.1.14. This flaw could allow malicious X clients with limited privileges to crash the X server or potentially execute code within the server context.
